channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 20
item.description:
72 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Advanced red toolbox loot crates now spawn debris (gibs) when emptied or destroyed.

World & AI

  • Fixed various AI movement problems: scientists now navigate correctly, crouch‑walk angles on stairs are accurate, older AI no longer slows down, and agents no longer get stuck.
  • Navmesh sampling now only uses reachable polygons, eliminating large frame‑time spikes on the oilrig when pathfinding to unreachable islands.
  • Deployable objects that span multiple rooms now work properly by being placed in their own network groups.

Items & Structures

  • Advanced red toolbox loot crates now spawn debris (gibs) when emptied or destroyed.
  • Krieg chainsword small weapon rack positioning corrected.
  • New repairable helipad at the bandit camp requires player‑contributed resources to unlock air vehicle purchases.

UI & Settings

  • ‘Show use bind’ and ‘Show belt bar binds’ settings now function correctly.
  • Conversation readout timings adjusted for smoother dialogue flow.

Server & Network Stability

  • Fixed server crash that occurred when validating player underwear during save.
  • Card table saving is now multithread‑friendly, preventing save errors.
  • Resolved null reference error when a planner places a collapsed renderer, eliminating related crashes.
  • Reduced the number of network groups for rooms, improving multiplayer performance.
